name: APT29 Persistence 1 - Script Dropped in the Startup Folder (T1547.001)
blast_radius: Writes a run-tagged .cmd into the per-user Startup folder, then removes it and verifies removal. It is never run at logon.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: file created in the Startup folder
detection: EDR: new script in the Startup folder written by a script host
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup') -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT29 Persistence 2 - Startup Shortcut Created and Its Target Modified (T1547.009)
blast_radius: Creates a run-tagged .lnk in the Startup folder, changes its arguments, then removes it and verifies removal. It is never run at logon.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: .lnk created and rewritten in the Startup folder
detection: EDR: shortcut modified in the Startup folder
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup') -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT29 Persistence 3 - WMI Permanent Event Subscription Created and Removed (T1546.003)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT29_WMI_SUBSCRIPTION=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates an event filter, a command-line consumer and a binding in root subscription with a run-tagged name and a filter that never fires, reads them back, then removes all three and verifies none remain.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 19, 20 and 21: WMI filter, consumer and binding
detection: EDR: new permanent WMI subscription with a command-line consumer
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$ns = 'root\subscription'
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName __FilterToConsumerBinding -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Filter.Name -like 'bas_a29_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'bas_a29_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName __EventFilter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'bas_a29_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT29 Persistence 4 - Scheduled Task Action Modified and Restored (T1053.005)
blast_radius: Registers its own run-tagged test task, modifies its action, restores it and deletes it. No existing task on the host is touched.
detection: SIEM: task action changed after creation
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a29_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'bas_a29_*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Unregister-ScheduledTask -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
